title: Two-star general furious at doctor's alien bodies question

tellings.quote: goes well there was this a two star general that came in here uh about six months ago and I did that same thing and he got furious with me

plain: A doctor near Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio is said to have asked a visiting two-star general about alien bodies, and the general "got furious with me." John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, who says he was abducted by an alien, tells it as what the unnamed doctor told him: the doctor had done "that same thing" to Blitch, and said a general who came in about six months earlier reacted with anger. Blitch tells it because the anger itself seemed to suggest the question hit something real.
